narrative.intro: National Government Services obligated $278M in FY2026 to date across 8 awards, with an average award size of $34.8M. National Government Services obligations are up 6.6% year over year. National Government Services recorded a multi-year obligation pattern of $256M in FY21, $254M in FY22, $285M in FY23, $186M in FY24, $261M in FY25, and $278M in FY26, showing recovery after FY24. National Government Services work in FY2026 to date concentrates in Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers at $204M, followed by Computer Systems Design Services at $64M and Other Computer Related Services at $10.3M. National Government Services shows relatively large average award size, which shapes pipeline and resourcing considerations for partners and subcontractors. National Government Services sales mix is heavily health-focused, with a secondary concentration in IT services, which should guide capture and technical approaches for contractors looking to work with the company on federal programs.

sections.heading: How has National Government Services' contracting trended over recent years?
sections.body: National Government Services obligated $256M in FY21, $254M in FY22, $285M in FY23, $186M in FY24, $261M in FY25, and $278M in FY26. National Government Services obligations are up 6.6% year over year, reflecting a rebound from FY24. National Government Services average award size in FY2026 to date is $34.8M across 8 awards. National Government Services year-to-date totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date obligations.

sections.heading: Where do National Government Services obligations go by market in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers account for $204M of National Government Services obligations in FY2026 to date. Computer Systems Design Services account for $64M and Other Computer Related Services account for $10.3M. National Government Services market mix indicates a dominant health-insurance focus and a significant IT-services component. National Government Services contractors and partners should prioritize health and IT capabilities accordingly.

faq.a: National Government Services has obligated $278M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. National Government Services has 8 awards in FY2026 to date, with an average award size of $34.8M. National Government Services obligations are up 6.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from National Government Services?
faq.a: National Government Services sells primarily to agencies and programs buying health and insurance services and IT, with Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers comprising $204M of obligations in FY2026 to date. National Government Services also serves buyers in Computer Systems Design Services at $64M and Other Computer Related Services at $10.3M.

faq.q: What does National Government Services sell to the government?
faq.a: National Government Services sells health insurance and related services along with IT services. National Government Services obligations in FY2026 to date are concentrated in Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers at $204M, and in Computer Systems Design Services at $64M and Other Computer Related Services at $10.3M.
